content.class.traveller.blurb: 你顺着河边的路下来，想借一条船。整个梅罗渡口，只有看守手里有船。
content.class.traveller.kit.0.name: 赶路的靴子
content.class.traveller.kit.2.name: 路上的药瓶
content.class.traveller.name: 旅人
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-bolt.opt.0.label: 好。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-bolt.text: 屋里的事都办完了，一样没乱。墙上三个按钮，一个顶掉一根销子。然后拉开门闩，船归你，到天黑为止。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.0.label: 怎么什么都拴着？
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.1.label: 我要借船。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.text: 想用我的船，屋里的事就得一样一样按顺序办。先敲钟，让对岸知道。再拿这把钥匙开库房。再开我的箱子。最后是墙上那三个按钮，还有船棚门上的门闩。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-why.opt.0.label: 回去。
content.dlg.keeper.keeper-why.text: 因为人见了东西就想按。谁碰都会动的东西，迟早被所有人碰个遍。在我这屋里，东西轮到了才动，没轮到就不动。
content.fx.sc.jetty-door.1.narrate: 门杠落下了。码头如今只隔一扇门。
content.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.answer: 这是看守的炉火。先跟她说过话，再来这里歇脚。
content.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.rest.0: 看守的炉火驱散了寒意。
content.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.rest_t: 炉火护着你，屋里的一切回到原样。
content.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.save_t: 炉火护着你；屋里什么都不会重置。
content.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.3.narrat: 看守递给你一把挂在钩子上的钥匙，解开了钟绳。她身后拉杆上的铁链也卸了，你可以在她炉膛里的火边歇脚了。
content.fx.the-house.oc.lift-the-lid.0.narrate: 箱子里有一瓶油。你把油抹进船棚门边那三个按钮里，直到它们按得动了。
content.fx.trig.button-one.1.narrate: 一根销子从门闩里掉了出来。
content.fx.trig.button-three.1.narrate: 一根销子从门闩里掉了出来。
content.fx.trig.button-two.1.narrate: 一根销子从门闩里掉了出来。
content.fx.trig.jetty-door-high-left.0.narrate: 这扇门从这一侧打不开。门杠在库房那边。
content.fx.trig.jetty-door-high-right.0.narrate: 这扇门从这一侧打不开。门杠在库房那边。
content.fx.trig.jetty-door-low-left.0.narrate: 这扇门从这一侧打不开。门杠在库房那边。
content.fx.trig.jetty-door-low-right.0.narrate: 这扇门从这一侧打不开。门杠在库房那边。
content.fx.trig.the-boulder.1.narrate: 大石头在你手下晃了晃，咚的一声往凹槽里又沉了一截。
content.fx.trig.the-lever.1.narrate: 码头底下有条铁链哗啦啦放了出去，船棚里的船撞了撞系船桩。
content.npc.keeper.name: 塔姆辛·梅罗
content.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.answers.done: 门闩已经拉开了。船棚的门开着。
content.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.answers.not_y: 门闩被销子卡死了。墙上那三个按钮能把销子顶掉。
content.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.hint: 按下墙上的三个按钮，再拉开船棚门边的门闩。
content.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.title: 拉开船棚门的门闩
content.obj.the-boat.enter-the-shed.hint: 船棚的门开了。船就在里面。
content.obj.the-boat.enter-the-shed.title: 走进船棚
content.obj.the-house.hear-the-keeper.hint: 看守站在厅里的柜台后面，从码头那道门进去就是。
content.obj.the-house.hear-the-keeper.title: 和看守说话
content.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.answers.not_y: 看守盯着呢，箱盖掀不开。先去开她的库房。
content.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.hint: 看守的箱子靠在厅里的墙边。
content.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.title: 掀开看守箱子的盖子
content.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.answers.done: 钟已经敲过了。对岸听见了。
content.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.answers.not_: 钟绳拴着。看守跟你说过话，才会给你解开。
content.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.title: 敲钟
content.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.answers.mi: 锁着。把看守的钥匙拿在手里，就能打开。
content.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.answers.no: 库房的门从里面闩着。先去敲钟。
content.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.hint: 库房的门在厅里的墙上，过了柜台就是。把看守的钥匙拿在手里。
content.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.title: 打开库房的门
content.quest.the-boat.goal: 用三个按钮顶掉船棚门闩上的三根销子，拉开门闩，走进船棚。
content.quest.the-house.goal: 和梅罗渡口的看守说话，敲响她的钟，用她的钥匙打开库房，再掀开她箱子的盖子。
content.shortcut.jetty-door.answers.done: 门杠已经卸下了。通往码头的门开着。
content.shortcut.jetty-door.answers.not_yet: 门杠插着。门杠在这一侧：门边的按钮能把它卸下。
content.state.pins-out.name: 已顶掉的销子
content.trigger.button-one.answers.done: 门闩早就拉开了。销子都掉光了。
content.trigger.button-one.answers.not_yet: 按钮锈死了，按不动。油在看守的箱子里。
content.trigger.button-three.answers.done: 门闩早就拉开了。销子都掉光了。
content.trigger.button-three.answers.not_yet: 按钮锈死了，按不动。油在看守的箱子里。
content.trigger.button-two.answers.done: 门闩早就拉开了。销子都掉光了。
content.trigger.button-two.answers.not_yet: 按钮锈死了，按不动。油在看守的箱子里。
content.trigger.the-boulder.answers.done: 大石头已经沉进凹槽里了，再也不会动了。
content.trigger.the-lever.answers.done: 拉杆已经扳过了，就停在那儿。
content.trigger.the-lever.answers.not_yet: 拉杆用铁链锁在墙上。看守跟你说过话，才会卸下铁链。
content.world.outro: 船棚的门开着，看守的船在系船桩边轻轻磕碰。梅罗渡口放你过去了。
content.world.title: 三个按钮一口钟

source.class.traveller.blurb: You came down the river road to borrow a boat, and the keeper of Merrow Landing is the only one who has one.
source.class.traveller.kit.0.name: Road boots
source.class.traveller.kit.2.name: Road flask
source.class.traveller.name: Traveller
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-bolt.opt.0.label: I will.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-bolt.text: The house is done, and done in its turn. Three buttons on the wall, one pin each. Then draw the bolt, and the boat is yours till sundown.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.0.label: Why is everything tied up?
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.opt.1.label: I need the boat.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-root.text: Nobody takes my boat who has not done the house in its turn. Ring the bell, so the far bank knows. Then the store, with this key. Then my chest. Then the three buttons on the wall, and the bolt on the shed gate.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-why.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.keeper.keeper-why.text: Because people press things. A thing that moves for anybody gets moved by everybody. In this house a thing moves when its turn comes, and not before.
source.fx.sc.jetty-door.1.narrate: The bar falls away. The jetty is one door away now.
source.fx.the-boat.done.0.narrate: The boat is yours to take.
source.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.answer: This is the keeper's fire. Speak to her before you rest here.
source.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.rest.0: The keeper's fire takes the chill off.
source.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.rest_t: The fire keeps you, and the house sets itself back up.
source.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.2.save_t: The fire keeps you; nothing in the house is reset.
source.fx.the-house.oc.hear-the-keeper.3.narrat: The keeper hands you a key on a hook and unties the bell rope. The lever behind her is unchained, and you may rest at her fire in the hearth.
source.fx.the-house.oc.lift-the-lid.0.narrate: There is a flask of oil in the chest. You work it into the three buttons by the shed gate until they give.
source.fx.trig.button-one.1.narrate: A pin knocks out of the bolt.
source.fx.trig.button-three.1.narrate: A pin knocks out of the bolt.
source.fx.trig.button-two.1.narrate: A pin knocks out of the bolt.
source.fx.trig.jetty-door-high-left.0.narrate: The door does not open from this side. It is barred from the store.
source.fx.trig.jetty-door-high-right.0.narrate: The door does not open from this side. It is barred from the store.
source.fx.trig.jetty-door-low-left.0.narrate: The door does not open from this side. It is barred from the store.
source.fx.trig.jetty-door-low-right.0.narrate: The door does not open from this side. It is barred from the store.
source.fx.trig.the-boulder.1.narrate: The boulder rocks under your hand and settles deeper into its socket with a thud.
source.fx.trig.the-lever.1.narrate: Under the jetty a chain runs out, and the boat in the shed knocks against its mooring.
source.npc.keeper.name: Tamsin Merrow
source.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.answers.done: The bolt is drawn. The shed gate stands open.
source.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.answers.not_y: The bolt is pinned fast. The three buttons on the wall knock its pins out.
source.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.hint: Press the three buttons on the wall, then draw the bolt beside the shed gate.
source.obj.the-boat.draw-the-bolt.title: Draw the bolt on the shed gate
source.obj.the-boat.enter-the-shed.hint: The shed gate is open. The boat is inside.
source.obj.the-boat.enter-the-shed.title: Go into the boat shed
source.obj.the-house.hear-the-keeper.hint: The keeper stands at her counter in the hall, through the doorway off the jetty.
source.obj.the-house.hear-the-keeper.title: Speak to the keeper
source.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.answers.done: Empty. You took the oil already.
source.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.answers.not_y: The lid will not lift while the keeper watches. Open her store first.
source.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.hint: The keeper's chest is against the hall's wall.
source.obj.the-house.lift-the-lid.title: Lift the lid of the keeper's chest
source.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.answers.done: The bell has been rung. The far bank heard it.
source.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.answers.not_: The bell rope is tied up. The keeper unties it once she has spoken to you.
source.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.hint: The bell stands on its post in the hall.
source.obj.the-house.ring-the-bell.title: Ring the bell
source.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.answers.mi: Locked. The keeper's key opens it, held in your hand.
source.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.answers.no: The store door is barred from within. Ring the bell first.
source.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.hint: The store door is in the hall's wall, past the counter. Hold the keeper's key.
source.obj.the-house.unbar-the-store.title: Unbar the store door
source.quest.the-boat.goal: Knock the three pins out of the shed gate's bolt with the three buttons, draw the bolt, and go into the boat shed.
source.quest.the-house.goal: Speak to the keeper of Merrow Landing, ring her bell, unbar her store with her key, and lift the lid of her chest.
source.shortcut.jetty-door.answers.done: The bar is thrown. The door to the jetty stands open.
source.shortcut.jetty-door.answers.not_yet: Barred. The bar is on this side: the button beside the door throws it.
source.state.pins-out.name: Pins out
source.trigger.button-one.answers.done: The bolt is already drawn. The pins are all out.
source.trigger.button-one.answers.not_yet: The button is stiff with rust. The oil is in the keeper's chest.
source.trigger.button-three.answers.done: The bolt is already drawn. The pins are all out.
source.trigger.button-three.answers.not_yet: The button is stiff with rust. The oil is in the keeper's chest.
source.trigger.button-two.answers.done: The bolt is already drawn. The pins are all out.
source.trigger.button-two.answers.not_yet: The button is stiff with rust. The oil is in the keeper's chest.
source.trigger.the-boulder.answers.done: The boulder has already settled into its socket. It will not move again.
source.trigger.the-lever.answers.done: The lever is thrown, and it stays thrown.
source.trigger.the-lever.answers.not_yet: The lever is chained to the wall. The keeper unchains it once she has spoken to you.
source.world.outro: The shed gate stands open and the keeper's boat knocks at its mooring. Merrow Landing has let you through.
source.world.title: Three Buttons and a Bell
